Method of Attack: Used in critical infrastructure attacks targeting water utility providers' smart meter base stations (TGBs), disabling communication and changing passwords to offensive words
Impacted Systems: Smart water meter base stations (Tower Gateway Basestations - TGBs) used by water utility providers
Attack Vector: Exploitation of insider knowledge by a former employee to access and disable TGB devices
Indicators of Compromise: Disabled communication of TGBs, changed passwords to offensive words, incidents traced to six events in five US East Coast cities
